changes.title: Berry costs
items: A youth now grows into an adult on 3, 4 or 8 berries (light, normal or strong kinds), half what it was, and berry patches are half as common

changes.title: Ladder far dither
items: Automatic quality's first step: in the treetops the forest's far edge now dissolves in a pixel dither instead of a soft fade, about a third quicker to draw on a slow graphics card

changes.title: Quality ladder
items: Automatic quality: on a slow graphics card the game now plains down a step at a time to keep the frame rate (tall trees shorter, leaves still, then a steady 30 fps), and climbs back when there's room. The pause page shows the step it's on and can pin one or turn it off
